title: ALMA Reveals Metals yet No Dust within Multiple Components in CR7
question: Are there metals and dust in CR7 (z=6.6 Lyα emitter), and do metallicity and dust content vary between its UV clumps?

data.sensitivity: rms 0.06 mJy/beam per 38.8 km/s channel; continuum rms 7 uJy/beam

what.value: HST F110W/F160W photometry of clumps A, B, C

evidence.quote: The latest photometry on the *HST*/WFC3 imaging in the F110W and F160W filters has been performed by (cite: Bowler2016).

what.value: COSMOS2015 catalog IDs/photo-z of foreground galaxies

evidence.quote: associated with ID number 339509 in the catalog from (cite: Laigle2016), photo$-z=0.84$

what.value: Literature [CII]/SFR/UV-slope samples and local SFR-L[CII] relation

evidence.quote: we show how our [Cii] measurements of the UV components of CR7, their sum, and the integrated CR7 measurements compare to samples at $z\sim5-7$ and to the local relation.

recipe.method: CASA reduction, natural weighting, channel averaging to 38.8 km/s, uv taper 0.7''
Shift ALMA by 0.25'' west to align [CII] clumps with UV clumps A and B; consistent with foreground continuum sources
assumptions: Offset is due to astrometry errors, not physical

recipe.method: Integrate flux in 100,000 random circular apertures on collapsed image, r=0.35''
key_parameters: 1 sigma = 16.9 mJy/beam km/s for beam-sized apertures

recipe.goal: Measure [CII] luminosities and line profiles of clumps
recipe.method: Aperture photometry (0.35'' radius; 0.55'' for A, 0.50'' for C-2) and Gaussian line fits; L_CII from Solomon/Carilli-Walter formula
key_parameters: L_CII/Lsun = 1.04e-3 x S dv x nu_obs x D_L^2, D_L = 64457.8 Mpc

recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fits with fixed beam shape and positions, noise added from random cutouts, 5000 repeats; deconvolve; M_dyn formula
Correct F110W for Lyα, compute beta, SFR_UV with Meurer1999 attenuation, 10,000 Monte Carlo perturbations
assumptions: Salpeter IMF 0.1-100 Msun; Meurer attenuation law

recipe.goal: IR continuum limits, dust mass and SFR_IR
recipe.method: 3 sigma limit from 7 uJy/beam rms; modified blackbody at T_d=35 K (also 25, 45 K); dust mass with kappa=1.875(nu/239.84)^beta m2/kg; Kennicutt SFR_IR
assumptions: CMB contribution removed; [CII] line contamination negligible

recipe.goal: Combine UV and IR for SFR_UV+IR
recipe.method: Require dust-corrected minus dust-free SFR < 5.4 Msun/yr in each of 10,000 realisations

recipe.goal: Place clumps on SFR-L[CII] relation and infer metallicity
recipe.method: Compare with local relation and literature, and Vallini2015 metallicity models

evidence.quote: we measure L$_{\rm [CII]}$ = $2.17\pm0.36\times10^8$ L$_{\odot}$ in the collapsed image
best-fitted with a line-width of $v_{\rm FWHM}=299\pm27$ km s$^{-1}$
M$_{\rm dust} < 8.1 (27.5)\times10^6$ M$_{\odot}$ if the dust temperature is 35 (25) K
dust obscured SFR$_{\rm IR} < 5.4$ M$_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$
we find that the components in CR7 would have gas-metallicities $0.1<$ Z/Z$_{\odot}<0.2$

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels and continuum subtraction (none applied to [CII]; the continuum image includes the line)
Cleaning parameters (deconvolver, threshold, masks, cell size) for tclean
Exact velocity range/channel selection for the collapsed images and velocity slices
Conversion constants for UV SFR (UV luminosity to SFR calibration)
Whether archive pipeline or manual calibration was used
The Lyα redshift reference used for velocity zero point
missing_for_reproduction: Exact velocity ranges for collapsed maps
Aperture centres and UV SFR calibration constant
score_reason: Public data and a clear measurement recipe, but imaging parameters are missing and the conclusions quote different limits than the body.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, moderately complete recipe, numeric main results (L[CII], limits).
